name: Drum Sampler
purpose: SFZ sample player that turns MIDI from the DAW into drum sounds from a chosen kit; the sound source for the software drums chain.

params.name: Volume
params.ai_hint: Overall kit level; set so peaks sit around -10 dBFS before processing.

params.name: Sample quality
params.ai_hint: Interpolation quality. Higher costs more CPU; 2 is fine for tracking.

notes: Parameters map to sfizz C API calls (sfizz_set_volume, sfizz_set_sample_quality), not plugin ports, so they are written by hand.
Volume is in dB: sfizz's own bounds are -144 to +48 dB (src/sfizz/Defaults.cpp); narrowed here to -60 to +6 dB.
Kit selection is handled by Plugsalot's kit library (a separate catalogue of SFZ kits and their licences), not by this module's parameters.
sfizz's oversampling setter is an inactive stub as of 1.0, so it is not exposed.
